doc.title: Alicia Olatuja interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 9, 2018

title: Name that Alicia tune: 'Truth in Blue'
summary: Rowe plays a score and asks about an unexpected half-step note in 'Truth in Blue'.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Yeah. Okay. I want to Name that Alicia tune.
Oh. Who plays this, me or the —
Oh God, are you doing this to me? These are the students, they should be sight reading.
Well this thing has been stuck in my head.
So I wanted to — you passed the audition.
I wanted to ask you about that note.
Wow. My ears were expecting an F sharp I guess. Do you remember that?
